
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/ctzss/p/19401200" title="发布于 2025-12-25 21:09">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">agc011_e 题解</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>一种 luogu 题解区没有的新做法。</p>
<p>考虑一个非常有道理的贪心：假设当前的数是 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span>，<strong>每次选择 <span class="math inline">\(\le n\)</span> 的最大的递增数 <span class="math inline">\(v\)</span></strong>，将 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 变为 <span class="math inline">\(n-v\)</span>。</p>
<blockquote>
<p>考虑上面的加粗部分比较抽象，实际上，比如样例 <span class="math inline">\(n=20170312\)</span>，那么 <span class="math inline">\(v=19999999\)</span>。</p>
</blockquote>
<p>感性理解就是一定会让最高位没掉。</p>
<p>但是直接做是 <span class="math inline">\(\mathcal{O}(n^2)\)</span> 的，考虑优化，如果使用线段树来维护高精度可以做到 <span class="math inline">\(\mathcal{O}(n\log n)\)</span>。</p>
<p>考虑继续优化，发现瓶颈在于每次减去形如 <span class="math inline">\(\overline{a}99\dots9\)</span>，则相当于先加减去一个 <span class="math inline">\(\overline{a}\times(10^k+1)\)</span>，再加 <span class="math inline">\(1\)</span>。发现前者会刚好消去当前这个数前若干位，而后者均摊是 <span class="math inline">\(\mathcal{O}(n)\)</span> 的，因此可以优化到 <span class="math inline">\(\mathcal{O}(n)\)</span>。</p>
<p>代码：</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">vector&lt;int&gt; num;
string str; cin &gt;&gt; str;
for (char c : str) num.pb(c - '0');
int step = 0, pos = -1, cur = 0;
while (true) {
  ++step;
  if (pos &lt; cur) {
    for (int i = cur; i + 1 &lt; num.size(); ++i) if (num[i] &gt; num[i + 1]) {
      pos = i;
      break;
    }
    if (pos &lt; cur) break;
  }
  int sep = num[pos];
  while (true) {
    int f = num[cur];
    ++cur;
    if (f == sep) break;
  }
  [&amp;]{
    for (int i = (int)num.size() - 1; i &gt;= cur; --i) {
      if (num[i] &lt; 9) {
        ++num[i];
        if (i &lt;= pos + 1) pos = cur - 1;
        return;
      }
      num[i] = 0;
    }
    --cur;
    num[cur] = 1;
    pos = cur - 1;
  }();
  while (num[cur] == 0) ++cur;
}
cout &lt;&lt; step &lt;&lt; "\n";
</code></pre>

</div>
<div class="clear"></div>
